name: loggy
description: Logs and feature flags for Next.js apps. Sets up loggy-next, debugs from your app's real browser and server logs, and runs your feature flags and alerts through Loggy's MCP server.

api_token.title: Loggy API token
api_token.description: Create one on the AI assistants page of your Loggy dashboard: https://loggy-next.vercel.app/ai. Tick "Can also make changes" to let Claude change flags and alerts too.

url.title: Loggy URL
url.description: Where your Loggy dashboard runs. Change it only for your own Loggy server, or http://localhost:3001 while developing Loggy.
